# Lumen 1.3.1

Hotfix release addressing upload engine edge cases, Android 12–15 background service limits, live network status detection, updater reliability, and additional security hardening.

---

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- Foreground Service Race Crash: Fixed a `ForegroundServiceDidNotStartInTimeException` crash that happened when running backup a second time on already-backed-up media where local cache hits finished in a few milliseconds.
- Android 12+ Background Auto-Backup: Added an expedited `BackgroundUploadWorker` fallback when Android blocks direct foreground service starts from the background, and held the `MediaContentJobService` job lease open until the upload queue finishes.
- Android 15+ Foreground Service Timeout: Implemented `Service.onTimeout()` on `UploadForegroundService` so long backup runs hitting Android 15's 6-hour `dataSync` limit stop cleanly instead of crashing the app.
- Live Offline Banner Detection: Wired `ConnectivityObserver` into the Backup screen and bumped offline priority above the "Backup Complete" state so turning off Wi-Fi or cellular while sitting on the Backup tab flips the hero banner to "No Internet Connection" immediately.
- Post-Backup Deletion Safety: Fixed `commitUpload` falling back to a fake `"uploaded_<timestamp>"` media key when Google returned an empty key on HTTP 200, which could previously trigger "Delete device copy after backup" before the file was actually committed to Google Photos.
- Recording Video Watermark Skip: Updated `FolderWatcherManager` to query `IS_PENDING=1` MediaStore entries and hold the folder watermark back behind in-progress camera recordings (up to 6 hours) so long videos aren't skipped once finalized.
- Upload Queue & Retry Fixes:
  - Fixed a race in `startQueue` where multiple coroutines could spawn duplicate worker loops.
  - Prevented old worker `finally` blocks from resetting `_isUploading` to `false` when a new queue restarts after a pause or token refresh.
  - Rethrew `CancellationException` during remote SHA-1 checks so pausing or cancelling stops workers immediately instead of falling through into a full byte upload.
  - Kept `TOKEN_EXPIRED` recoveries inside the normal retry loop and preserved target album settings (`targetAlbumMode`, `customAlbumName`, `customAlbumNickname`) and local hash caches across token refreshes and commit recoveries.
- Album Assignment & Resolution: Passed `originalFilePath` through to post-upload album assignment, added a synchronous `SettingsRepository.addAlbum` write before returning new album keys, and scoped the `resolveToMediaStoreUri` fallback by parent folder (`RELATIVE_PATH` / `BUCKET_DISPLAY_NAME`) so files with identical names like `IMG_0001.JPG` in different folders don't collide.
- Auth & Multi-Account Isolation:
  - Fixed `GoogleAuthClient.getBearerToken` throwing a generic `IOException` on 4xx responses before the error parser (`INVALID_GRANT`, `NEEDS_BROWSER`, `RATE_LIMITED`) could classify them.
  - Added a per-account mutex around token refreshes so parallel upload threads don't stampede Google's token endpoint at the same time.
  - Shared a single `GoogleAuthClient` instance across `AccountRepository` and `UploadRepository`, normalized account emails case-insensitively, isolated circuit-breaker blocks per account instead of stopping all accounts, and routed watched folders to their assigned `accountEmail`.
- Staging Cache Cleanup: Cleaned up `cache/staging/` temp files when cancelling a queue, clearing completed items, hitting an account block, or starting the app.
- In-App Update Checker:
  - Switched `LumenUpdateCheck` periodic work to a 4-hour interval with `ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.UPDATE` and exponential backoff retries (`Result.retry()`).
  - Deduplicated background update notifications so you only get notified once per new release version, fixed the notification small icon to use the monochrome vector, handled tapping the notification while the app is already open via `onNewIntent`, and throttled cold-start update checks to once every 12 hours.
  - Hidden the web-only `### Downloads` section from the in-app update sheet.

---

### Security Hardening
- Share Target Path & URI Validation: Restricted incoming `ACTION_SEND` / `ACTION_SEND_MULTIPLE` intents to external `content://` URIs, canonicalized resolved paths to block access to Lumen's internal app sandbox (`/data/data`, `filesDir`, `cacheDir`), and only trusted `_data` file paths when returned by the system `media` provider.
- WebView Session Cookie Wipe: Flushed and cleared all `WebView` cookies immediately after capturing the OAuth token and on dialog dismissal so Google session cookies don't sit on disk in `app_webview/Default/Cookies`, and required URL-based token extraction to match `accounts.google.com`.
- Bounded GZIP Decompression: Capped `GooglePhotosClient.uncompressIfNeeded` at 16 MB in 8 KB chunks to guard against malformed GZIP payloads exhausting heap memory.
- APK Signature Pre-Verification: Updated `launchApkInstall` to compare the downloaded APK's SHA-256 signing certificate against the installed app via `GET_SIGNING_CERTIFICATES` before launching the system package installer.
- Crash Log Redaction: Passed uncaught exception messages, stack traces in `lumen_crash.log`, and exported log bundles through `LumenLogger.redact()`.
- Release Signing Guard: Removed the debug keystore fallback on the `release` build type so release tasks fail fast if signing credentials are missing.
- CI/CD Supply Chain Pinning: Pinned all GitHub Actions in `ci.yml` and `release.yml` to full 40-character commit SHAs and set explicit `contents: read` default workflow permissions.
- Resource Cleanup: Removed an unused leftover `res/xml/config.xml` file.
